responsive.condition: Inline facets crowd search or leave too little room for results.
responsive.restructure: Move advanced facets to a labeled panel or modal sheet while leaving active count, query summary and reset accessible.
responsive.focusContinuity: Return to the same filter trigger on close; result replacement does not steal input focus.

responsive.condition: Columns no longer fit at readable size or text is enlarged.
responsive.restructure: Choose labeled scoped horizontal scrolling for comparison, or labeled stacked records for task scanning; expose all secondary values in reachable detail.
preservedInformation: Authorized actions and all column values
responsive.focusContinuity: Keep selected IDs and sort state; restore focus to the same record action after detail navigation, or the collection heading if removed.

responsive.condition: Columns would separate labels from controls or create cramped fields.
responsive.restructure: Stack task groups in reading order; keep actions reachable without a sticky region obscuring focused inputs or errors.
responsive.focusContinuity: Keep the same field focused on resize; reveal hidden sections before error-link focus.

skillReads.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la; cat .agents/skills/udi-design/SKILL.md; cat data.js; cat tokens.css; ls tools'

responsive.condition: Column comparison is the primary task and readable columns exceed available width, including tablet or enlarged text.
responsive.restructure: Keep a semantic table in one named horizontal scroll region with native scrollbar visibility (auto); preserve row identity and place the frequent authorized action beside the identity or in a persistent, non-overlapping action area without horizontal travel. Do not convert comparison tasks to cards automatically.
preservedInformation: Record identity and full name access
Every comparable column and selected scope
Prioritized authorized action without horizontal travel
responsive.focusContinuity: Retain record IDs, query and sort; reveal focused cells/controls without obscuring them. Restore the same record action after details.

responsive.condition: Individual record lookup or editing matters more than simultaneous column comparison on a narrow screen.
responsive.restructure: Use a task-focused row summary with identity, critical status/value and authorized primary action; disclose labeled secondary fields on demand. A summary is not a forced card layout. Keep one active semantic representation and offer comparison when the task still requires it.
preservedInformation: All secondary values through a named details control
responsive.focusContinuity: Details return to the same record; do not duplicate tabbable controls or lose selection on layout changes.

responsive.condition: No records are displayed: initial empty, zero matches, loading or error.
responsive.restructure: Keep query, scope and recovery meaningful; do not create an empty horizontal scroll track from a minimum-width header. Hide or constrain the unused table region while preserving loading/status announcements and Clear or Retry.
responsive.focusContinuity: Keep focus on the initiating query/control, or move deliberately to an announced recovery destination.

responsive.condition: Facets crowd search/results at narrow or tablet widths, or selected values are long.
responsive.restructure: Move advanced facets into a named disclosure or one focus-managed sheet. Keep query, result meaning, active conditions and Clear reachable; prefer wrapping chips. Horizontal chip scrolling is conditional: show an edge cue or previous/next controls, reveal focused removals and never silently clip selected scope.
responsive.focusContinuity: Closing returns to the trigger; removing a chip moves focus to the next relevant chip or Clear/search. Result updates do not steal typing focus.

responsive.condition: A filter sheet is shorter than its fields, especially with an on-screen keyboard.
responsive.restructure: Use one vertical body scroll owner, with Apply/reset reachable by scrolling or non-obscuring actions. Avoid an independently scrolling chip rail nested inside the sheet when wrapping suffices. Scrollbar auto is default; conceal only with equivalent discoverable operation.
preservedInformation: Draft values and active query distinction
responsive.focusContinuity: Bring focused options into the usable viewport and return to the same trigger; preserve drafts on resize according to the declared policy.

responsive.condition: Fields or actions no longer fit readable columns, including narrow, tablet, enlarged text or short usable viewport.
responsive.restructure: Stack related fields in reading order. For an overlay, give its body one vertical scroll owner constrained by the usable viewport; keep Save/Cancel reachable without clipping and reveal focused inputs/errors above any sticky actions. Use native scrollbar auto by default, not global overflow locking.
responsive.focusContinuity: Retain the same field across resize. Error links reveal the containing section and scroll the target clear of fixed chrome; close returns to the invoker.

responsive.condition: The page or another overlay already owns scrolling.
responsive.restructure: Choose page editing or one modal focus owner deliberately; avoid simultaneously scrolling form, dialog and page for the same task. A temporary modal background lock must be scoped, preserve page position and restore scrolling on every exit.
responsive.focusContinuity: Test Tab and Shift+Tab, Escape and error focus in a short viewport; do not treat a transient BODY stop alone as proof of background control access.
